the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: over the algebraic closure, the commutator morphism h: (x, y) -> (x, xyx^{-1}y^{-1}) is a morphism over the first projection, constant on the fibre e x A; the collapse lemma gives a neighbourhood U of e over which the fibres of h are finite, so for each x in U(k) the commutator endomorphism y -> xyx^{-1}y^{-1} of A has finite image; being a group homomorphism on the connected variety A, its image is connected and finite, hence the single point e; thus the commutator is trivial on U x A, and translating by U-points covers A(k), forcing the group law to be abelian (source lines 1873-1893)
